## Houston v0.6.11

- Cloud work now recovers more reliably when agents wake, laptops reconnect, or storage briefly stalls.
- OpenAI-compatible setup issues now show clear actions to reconnect or switch to an available model.
- Cloud agents can now run local code in isolated workers and keep the files they create.
- Azure OpenAI connections now keep the correct endpoint across agents and restarts after you reconnect once.
- Stability and polish improvements under the hood.

### Before you upgrade

- Quit Houston before installing. macOS does not always replace an app that is running.
